## Data platforms, built to last

::: {.feature-grid}
::: {.feature-card style="--accent-color: var(--accent-1);"}
[🏗️]{.feature-icon}

### Data lake architecture

Designing data models and lake architectures from scratch on AWS (S3, Glue, Athena, Lambda, ECS, RDS) — including entity-level historical tracking of change over time.
:::

::: {.feature-card style="--accent-color: var(--accent-2);"}
[⚙️]{.feature-icon}

### Production ELT pipelines

Building and operating pipelines with dbt, Airflow, PySpark and Polars — optimized for reliability at GB-scale, not just for the demo.
:::

::: {.feature-card style="--accent-color: var(--accent-3);"}
[🤖]{.feature-icon}

### LLM-powered enrichment

Structured, production-grade pipelines using OpenAI/Anthropic APIs for translation, entity matching and classification — with retries, caching and provider abstraction.
:::

::: {.feature-card style="--accent-color: var(--accent-4);"}
[📐]{.feature-icon}

### Reusable infrastructure & governance

Python libraries, CI/CD standards and data quality monitoring adopted across 8–10+ repos and 10+ teams — documentation-first, versioned, and built for other engineers to build on.
:::
:::

A background in physics and energy engineering shaped how I work: understand the system first, question assumptions, and let the data guide the decision. Outside of production work, I build small end-to-end projects — a from-scratch Iceberg lakehouse, dbt on real open weather data, a PyTorch mushroom classifier — to learn technologies hands-on before they show up at work. See [Projects](projects.qmd) for details.
